(2) The consumer at bb07fdd carries the guard '#if RCLCPP_VERSION_GTE(30, 1, 5)' selecting the const-ref override, so against 30.1.5 (by-value) the override matches no base declaration - matches the compiler error. (3) PR 3198 body verbatim: 'I misconfigured the version macro with #3080. It is a GTE and not a GT macro', merge 64f9645a; PR 3080 title 'Fix API breaking change of Executor::add_node'. (4) Failing runs 24018250241/24063312146 head bb07fdd conclusion failure; success run 24116710553 head 64f9645a conclusion success. (5) E3 DIRECTION CAVEAT (spec itself flags it in notes): the provider in the failing composition is rclcpp 30.1.5, OLDER than the consumer's selected declaration (31.0.0), i.e. the reverse of the canonical UPGRADE ('provider runs at a newer revision than the consumer was built or written against'). The unit that changed was the consumer (PR #3080), not the provider. Strictly this is a consumer-runs-ahead version skew rather than UPGRADE; the failure is still a genuine library-API interface mismatch and the case is eligible at step 6 either way, so eligibility verdict stands but the operation label is contestable. (6) Failed condition class element_retyped (add_node declaration changed by-value->const-ref, element still present) is correct; no missed conditions (the MockExecutor only overrides add_node; the other const-ref changes in f145c9ee do not surface in this test file).
